ALGO.description: Compression algorithm to use for zram (e.g., lz4, zstd).

PERCENT.description: Percentage of total RAM to use for zram swap. Takes precedence over SIZE.

SIZE.description: Static amount of RAM (in MiB) to use for zram devices. Ignored if PERCENT is set.

PRIORITY.description: Priority for the zram swap devices. Higher number means higher priority.
